steps.reason: feel_temp is almost the same column as temp (correlation 0.99); keeping both only adds collinearity for linear models.
The target is continuous, so there are no classes to stratify on; a seeded random 80/20 split keeps the run reproducible.
Text categories with four values and no missing values; one-hot is the family-neutral encoding.

Numeric columns on different scales. month, hour and weekday are categories stored as integers; no step can encode a numeric column, so they stay ordered numbers. The model family is open and may include linear models; scaling costs trees nothing and puts linear models on comparable footing.
